disposition_reason: Prints per-product values (Table 4), summary statistics (Table 5) and category medians with quartiles (Table 7) for 13 elements, including lead, cadmium, arsenic and mercury, in 40 cornflake products sold in the UAE.

study.design: retail market survey of 40 cornflake SKUs
study.origin: France 13, UK 7, USA 6, Switzerland 4, Poland 3, India 2, Spain 2, Germany 1, Malta 1, Mexico 1 (Table 6)
study.market: major retail outlets, United Arab Emirates
study.period_text: three months in the summer of 2022
study.method: ICP-MS (Thermo, He collision mode, EPA 6020B) after microwave digestion of 0.5 g in HNO3/H2O2 with HCl
